jobs.description:
About the Boerma Instituut

The Boerma Instituut was founded in 1980 by Theo and Jose Boerma and is currently led by Jacqueline Boerma, fourth generation of a family with more than 120 years of experience in floral design.

The school offers foundation courses, international programmes, workshops, masterclasses and the Master Florist programme (Meesterbinder). Our mission is to train students from all over the world to become professional florists and floral designers.

Position

As a Floral Design Instructor, you will teach classical and modern floral design, guide international students and represent the school abroad. The role includes teaching in the Netherlands as well as international travel.

Responsibilities

- Teach International Vocational, Advanced and Master Florist programmes, levels 1 to 3
- Teach hand-tied bouquet courses and floral courses for funerals, weddings and events
- Provide private lessons and group training
- Prepare lessons, order materials and create sample pieces
- Coach and mentor students
- Support competitions, events and open days
- Travel internationally to teach and demonstrate on behalf of the school

Requirements

- Master Florist Diploma (Meesterbinder) with transcript
- Average grade of 8 or international equivalent
- Transcript must be submitted
- Knowledge of the Golden Ratio, proportion, Fibonacci composition and asymmetrical floral design
- Teaching experience at Master Florist level is required
- Extensive portfolio of own work; the portfolio must be submitted before the interview
- Knowledge of colour theory and correct nomenclature of flowers, plants and materials
- Willingness to learn Dutch
- English is currently the working language
- Minimum of 10 years of professional floral design experience
- Minimum of 3 years of teaching or training experience
- Experience with international competitions and demonstrations
- Valid category B driving licence
- Strong artistic vision, technical skills, pedagogical skills and flexibility to travel internationally

SSAB Services, Hardox Wearparts is a rapidly growing business unit with ambitious targets. As Business & Technical Development Manager for Hardox Wearparts you will be an integral part of building and implementing a new business model. 

You will participate in the development and conceptualization of the new business model, including the future product and service mix as well as the go-to market setup. Placement is optional.

•Development of trainings and manuals

•Piloting the new concept, preparing for future concept sales

Your qualifications
To be successful in this role you need to have a master degree in engineering or equivalent.

You are fluent in English and thrive in an international environment where global contacts are part of the every day work. Speaking Dutch is a plus as the position wil be based in the Netherlands.

As a person you are positive and interested in new ideas - and in making them happen. 

We offer
You will be part of, and have the possibility to grow within, an international and dynamic organization that is developing rapidly. Hardox Wearparts has ambitious growth targets and as a vital member of the development team, you will contribute to our future success. 

Application
Send your application no later than 20th of March 2019

For more information, please contact
Nancy Matos, Manager Hardox Wearparts Concept, phone +46 155 255 422

Our client is a European tech group operating across mobility and renewable energy, with several complementary businesses spanning digital media, training, e-commerce, and software.The role focuses on their EV charging platform, a scale-up offering a leading consumer app, a roaming charging solution used across Europe, and a growing B2B SaaS platform for corporate fleets.As part of their international expansion, they are now appointing a Country Manager to build and lead the BeLux market.

Jobomschrijving

As Country Manager, your main responsibilities will be to :

Shape & own the BeLux market strategy

• Define the market vision and priorities for Belgium & Luxembourg, adapting the global framework to local realities.
• Build a deep understanding of drivers, barriers, competitors, and user/company behaviors to inform strategic decisions.
• Identify high-impact growth levers across B2C and B2B.

Accelerate B2C adoption & engagement

• Boost usage of the mobile app and charging access solution through creative, locally relevant activation.
• Work with Marketing on targeted campaigns and growth experiments; ensure seamless onboarding with Customer Success.
• Influence product developments by sharing market insights and feature needs with Product & Tech.

Drive B2B development & support fleet electrification

• Analyze fleet maturity and corporate charging needs to position the B2B SaaS offer effectively.
• Partner with Marketing & Sales to build a solid lead generation engine and qualify opportunities.
• Secure customer satisfaction and long-term usage through close collaboration with Customer Success and B2B Ops.

Turn strategy into execution & measurable results

• Own the BeLux KPIs and P&L: monitor performance, detect weak signals, and propose data-backed improvements.
• Deploy clear action plans and ensure cross-functional alignment for efficient execution.
• Be the operational link between market needs and central teams (Sales, Product, Tech, Marketing, CS).

Build and represent the brand in the local ecosystem

• Become the face of the company in the BeLux market: attend events, engage communities, and expand visibility.
• Develop partnerships with charging networks, installers, service providers, driver associations, and corporate stakeholders.
• Conduct initial discovery visits with prospects, validate opportunities, and coordinate handovers to internal Business Developers.

Prepare the ground for future local expansion

• Identify organizational needs as the market grows and contribute to planning a future local team (Sales, Marketing, etc.).
• Ensure continuous feedback loops to refine positioning, operations, and product-market fit.

The successful candidate will have the following qualities:

• Relevant experience in market development / new market launch / acceleration (ideally in SaaS, digital products, mobility, energy)
• Proven ability to adapt a global strategy to local dynamics and deliver measurable growth.
• Data-driven: confident with KPIs, dashboards, CRM, and translating field insights into action.
• Strong partnership-building mindset with companies, associations, and institutional stakeholders.
• Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and autonomous, with excellent cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Deep understanding of BeLux cultural and business context; EV ecosystem knowledge is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: Manager Consolidation and Reporting - Walloon Brabant
jobs.description:
A European industrial group operating in multiple countries is reinforcing its Group Finance structure and is hiring a Consolidation & Group Reporting Manager (or Expert).

The group works with complex operations, numerous entities and a strong international footprint, requiring robust reporting frameworks and high-quality consolidated financials.

Their offices are located in Walloon Brabant.

Jobomschrijving

You will lead the consolidation and reporting function, oversee IFRS compliance and safeguard the accuracy, consistency and timeliness of group accounts. As a key advisor to senior finance leadership, you will drive harmonisation of accounting practices and continuous improvement of the consolidation environment.

Key Responsibilities :

• Steer the monthly, quarterly and annual consolidation under IFRS
• Ensure quality and completeness of consolidated accounts (eliminations, minority interests, acquisitions/divestments…)
• Lead the preparation of the group's statutory financial statements and quarterly reporting
• Act as main point of contact for external auditors
• Participate to the migration to a new consolidation system (currently HFM)
• Develop reporting structures, dashboards and closing-process improvements
• Support M&A activities (PPA, integration, system setup)
• Collaborate closely with FP&A, treasury and local accounting teams
• Possibility to manage one consolidation analyst (depending on experience).

• Master's degree in Finance/Accounting; professional qualification (CPA, ACCA…) is an asset
• 6-12 years of experience in Consolidation within an international context
• Strong IFRS expertise and ability to handle complex accounting topics
• Rigorous, analytical and comfortable with tight deadlines
• Excellent communication with the ability to influence stakeholders across countries
• Fluent in English (French is a plus).

jobs.occupation: Warehouse job: order picker in day shift
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

This is a job posting intended to create a reserve pool of candidates. 

Do you have a first experience in order picking or production ?  Are you organized and punctual ?  Would you like to contribute to the medical world ?  Then this job could be a perfect fit.  Our client conducts medical research using blood and urine samples and your role will be to assemble the medical kits.

The job

• Pick the required materials following the pick lists
• Assemble the medical kits 
• Assign the packaged kits to the correct shipping order
• Handle this with great care and ensure all orders are processed accurately
You will be working from Monday to Friday: 7h30 - 15h36 or 14h00 -22h06 (with a half hour break)

 

 

• Good knowledge of English
• Relevant  experience in orderpicking or production

jobs.occupation: Inetum - Data & AI Impact Consultant Engineer

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.

• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.

• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - part-time or weekend work
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!
